svg.title: BC Forest Service poster - simplified revised paint construction
svg.desc: Editable all-path paint reconstruction. Source study native painted area x=6..668, y=8..936 is mapped to the 1000 by 1400 comparison plane. Large paint fields are manually composed; grain is synthesized from the supplied study model. RGB palette is adjusted to the supplied photograph, without claiming original-ink or print calibration. No raster image, live filter, gradient, external reference or opacity effect.
